The '''Geroon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geroon]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Geroon (species)|Geroon]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="OF" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />
